records.a:
Mandatory Order of evacuation for the souther portion of the parish
due to Tropical Storm Francine… this includes all areas south of the
Kelso Bayou Bridge on the west side of the Calcasieu Ship Channel and
all areas south of the Intercoastal Aaterway east of the Calcasiue
Shop Channel as of 2:00 PM on Monday, September 9, 2024. This includes
the communites of Hackberry, Johnson Bayou, Holly Beach, Cameron ...

Mandatory evacuation for Zone 1 starting now. Residents must be out by
6 AM on Wednesday, September 11, 2024.

A mandatory evacuation of areas of Jefferson Parish located outside of
the Hurricane and Storm Damage Risk Reduction System
All residents south of US highway 90.

Mandatory Order of evacuation for the remaining areas of Cameron
Parish.

Voluntary Evacuation for the following areas: Alliance to Venice on
the Westbank, Entire Eastbank

Mandatory Evacuation for the following areas: Lake Hermitage, Happy
Jack, Myrtle Grove, Tidewater Rd., Venice, White Ditch to Phoenix,
Woodpark, Grand Bayou.

For Grand Isle and Lafitte residents outside the levee protection
system.

Voluntary evacuations for the Lower Bayou Blue Community, Eagle Island
Road, anyone in a mobile home, low lying area and anyone feeling
vulnerable.

Mandatory evacuations for residents in a FEMA or State Housing Units
and South of the Leon Theriot Locks.
For those in low-lying areas and vulnerable populations

Voluntary evacuation of all of Assumption Parish, especially those in
low-lying areas, mobile homes, RV’s and/or substandard structures.

Voluntary Evacuation Requested For Lower St. Martin Parish
(Stephensville and Belle River). A voluntary evacuation is encouraged
for the safety of residents in these low-lying areas.

For all areas South of LA 83, South of Glencoe which includes the Port
of West St. Mary, all of Cypremort Point and Louisa,as well as Hwy 317
south of the levee near Lukes landing road.

All persons in designated evacuation areas are recommended to consider
temporarily relocating to safer locations for their own safety.

For all low-lying areas, residents living on rivers, river inlets,
bayous, creeks, and in travel trailers, modular homes or mobile homes,
homes under construction and or partially constructed homes.
Order for Hackberry downgraded to a voluntary evacuation order.

Cameron Parish OHSEP to release the entire parish from mandatory
evacuation order.
